text: Stonehenge's six-ton mystery stone just lost its home... again.
Scientists were sure it came from Scotland. Now? They say no.
It's called the Altar Stone. Six tons, sixteen feet long, lying right in the center.
In 2024, a study traced it to northeast Scotland. Over four hundred sixty miles away.
Which meant ancient people dragged six tons... across half of Britain.
But here's the twist. A new team collected seventy rock samples from that exact area.
They checked the grains, the minerals, the chemistry. A full geological fingerprint.
So the most famous rock in Britain... has no home again.
Geologists are now hunting in northern England, other parts of Scotland, and even Ireland.
Find the quarry, and we finally learn who moved it... and how.
Do you think they'll ever find it?
